# Salamander Grand Piano (sampled)

The default sound of REA's players: a Yamaha C5 grand recorded by
**Alexander Holm** as the *Salamander Grand Piano V3*, licensed under
**Creative Commons Attribution 3.0** (CC BY 3.0,
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).

These 30 files — one every minor third from A0 to C8, at one velocity — are
the MP3 set published by the Tone.js project
(https://tonejs.github.io/audio/salamander/), unchanged.  Notes between them
are played by retuning the nearest sample (never more than a semitone).

Original recordings: https://archive.org/details/SalamanderGrandPianoV3
